ContentType.name: EditorialAnnotation
ContentType.Description: Optional site-owned editorial metadata; existing article schemas remain independent.

Field.name: AccentColor
Field.Description: Optional six-digit hexadecimal colour, for example #2c4f52.

Field.name: Items
Field.Description: Optional distinct items within this site's editorial root. Existing legacy grouping fields remain independent.

Field.name: SequenceNumber
Field.Description: Positive sequence; zero means unassigned. Do not infer an edition order.

Field.name: PublisherSequence
Field.Description: Positive sequence; zero means unassigned. Do not infer an edition order.

Field.name: OriginalSequence
Field.Description: Positive sequence; zero means unassigned. Do not infer an edition order.

Field.name: TimelineSequence
Field.Description: Positive sequence; zero means unassigned. Do not infer an edition order.
